audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Sion level 2 while its own why calls it a skill window, and gave Skill at levels 4-5 and 6 while the prose says Sion owns both.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Skill, Skill, Sion, Sion, Sion, Sion, Sion, and the whys for 4-5 and 6 already describe Sion advantages (Soul Furnace, zombie passive).
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill, Skill, Sion, Sion, Sion, Sion, Sion.

audit.why: Spikes: levels 1-2 root trade, level 3 Sion takeover, level 6 zombie passive, 2+ items HP stacking — matches the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields claim Sion's E is a 'shield-break' that detonates Titan's Wrath. Roar of the Slayer does no such thing: it damages, slows and reduces ARMOR of the first enemy hit, at 800 range on 12/11/10/9/8s, and knocks a struck minion back through everything behind it. Decimating Smash was treated as a guaranteed knock-up when only a full charge stuns. Three flagged interactions were absent.
audit.why: Riot text for E and Q; missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal (Glory in Death heals off its rapid attacks), resistances-invalidated (max-health damage), and terrain-cuts-retreat (Unstoppable Onslaught).
audit.corrected: E shreds armour and slows — it does not touch your shield. Q stuns only at full charge, down 6-10s, so punish the empty swing. Grievous Wounds before you kill him, and hold Flash for his R cutting your retreat, not for the damage.

edits.before: At 3 his E shield-break detonates your W Titan's Wrath shield and his W chunks you on every walk-up — he owns short trades.
edits.after: At 3 Roar of the Slayer cuts your armour and slows at 800 range, and Soul Furnace shields then detonates — he owns short trades.

edits.before: His W shield plus E poke out-trade your shielded auto-burn, and a charged Q interrupts any Q-pull engage you try.
edits.after: Soul Furnace plus armour-shred poke out-trade your auto-burn, and a charged Decimating Smash stuns you out of the pull.

edits.before: Sion takes over: his E shield-break shreds your W Titan's Wrath bonus-HP shield and his W detonation chunks you whenever you walk up to last-hit.
edits.after: Sion takes over: Roar of the Slayer shreds your armour and slows at 800 range, and the Soul Furnace detonation chunks every walk-up you take.

edits.before: Proc E shield-break on you to detonate your W shield and chunk you for free
edits.after: Land Roar of the Slayer to shred your armour and slow you out of the trade

edits.before: From 3 on this gets ugly. His E shreds your W Titan's Wrath shield right as you pop it, so your shielded auto-burn trade pattern just doesn't land, and his W gives him a free shield-into-AOE every time you try to commit. Your only path is a Q pull into E slow into R when his Q is on cooldown — but if he max-charges Q he knocks you out of it. Look to roam or set ganks with R rather than win the 1v1.
edits.after: From 3 on this gets ugly. Roar of the Slayer shreds your armour and slows you at 800 range every 8-12 seconds, so your walk-ups cost more than they earn, and Soul Furnace hands him a shield into AOE each time you commit. Your path is a Q pull into E slow into R while Decimating Smash sits on its 6-10s cooldown — a full charge knocks you out of it. Roam or set ganks with R instead.

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Full charge knocks up and stuns; down 6-10s. Engage on the empty swing.

edits.before: Hook Sion as his answer goes down, passive-root, W-shield the return, E-slow the retreat — the chain does the rest.
edits.after: Charged Decimating Smash stuns; uncharged only damages — step out of the wind-up and punish the empty swing.

edits.before: That is Sion's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Grievous Wounds before you kill him: the zombie heals off every rapid attack.

edits.before: Whiffing hook and walking forward anyway — your kill threat IS the hook; without it you are a slow shield.
edits.after: Unstoppable Onslaught can cut off your retreat and you have no dash — hold Flash for the wall, not the damage.

edits.before: Track Sion's Decimating Smash (Stun): Charged = knockup. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Decimating Smash stuns only at full charge and is down 6-10s — Q-E + R him on the empty swing.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash: matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sion Decimating Smash: 6-10s — only a full charge knocks up and stuns. Track it before every engage. - Dredge Line: never spend it on chip. - Depth Charge: the win condition, kill windows only.

notes: The 'E shield-break' claim was invented and is now removed everywhere it drove advice. Ratings left as they were: the flipped rows already carry ratings consistent with the new sides (4/10 where Sion now owns the stage).
